result.instructions: Venti is a free app for paraglider pilots. This connector answers from public data the Venti server collects: wind measured by weather stations, and airspace. Give places as coordinates. Say how old a reading is and name the source of the data. Airspace answers are advice from data that is not certified and never a clearance: nothing here knows what is active today. The connector is open to everyone and knows nothing about the person asking.
